douse.definition:
v. put out, as of a candle or a light
v. wet thoroughly
v. lower quickly
v. slacken
douse.translation:
vt. 插入水中, 浇(或洒、泼)水在...上, 熄(灯、火等), 平息
vi. 浸泡
n. 泼洒

doused.translation: v. 浇水在…上( douse的过去式和过去分词 ); 熄灯[火]

douser.translation: [地质]探矿器, [军]有翼飞弹, 小汽车, 小飞机, 小火车, 防火门(放映室用)

douses.definition:
v put out, as of a candle or a light
v wet thoroughly
v dip into a liquid
v immerse briefly into a liquid so as to wet, coat, or saturate
v lower quickly
v slacken
v cover with liquid; pour liquid onto
douses.translation: v. 浇水在…上( douse的第三人称单数 ); 熄灯[火]
